attorneys: Milton A. Rudin for petitioner. Almon S. Nelson for respondent. Solicitor General Rankin filed a memorandum for the United States. Osmond K. Fraenkel for the Authors League of America, Inc.

opinions.text: The motion for leave to file brief of the Authors League of America, Inc., as amicus curiae, is granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied.
